children.text: We believe the best designs emerge when diverse voices come together to imagine and build with purpose.
LPAS Architecture + Design is an award-winning, multidisciplinary design firm providing architecture, interior design, and planning services across a diverse range of project types.

With offices in Sacramento and Oakland, LPAS works collaboratively with clients on higher education, civic, mixed-use, housing, commercial, and adaptive-reuse projects that respond to context, community, and purpose.
